description: Rename an agent below you when the user asks you to: one of your children by its name, or a deeper agent by its path. It keeps running and its own agents move with it. Its old name still reaches it and is never given to another agent.

name.description: A child's name, or the path of an agent further below you.

new_name.description: Its new name: a lowercase letter, then up to 31 of a-z, 0-9, _ and -.

name: rename_agent
